**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/22 (Mon) 22:25
- [FACT] User inquired about the peace between Russia and Japan after World War II.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Russia and Japan never officially declared war on each other during World War II.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There were a number of conflicts between Russia and Japan during World War II, including the Soviet invasion of Manchuria in 1945.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Soviet-Japanese War occurred in 1945.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The two countries did not establish diplomatic relations until 1956.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Soviet Union and Japan signed the Joint Declaration of 1956, which formally ended the state of war between the two countries.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Joint Declaration of 1956 also provided for the exchange of diplomats.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Joint Declaration of 1956 established cultural and economic ties between Russia and Japan.
